beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Paris exposes the technical production of legitimacy through calendar inclusion, monumental rooms, official images, digital programmes, showrooms and archives. This chapter follows memory: The venue disappears, schedules change and links decay; preservation choices determine which technical history remains citable and contestable.
beats.onScreen: Then: Palais Galliera, Paris Musées and Gallica expose different public memory systems: museum objects, open-image filters and digitized national collections.

beats.voice: Palais Galliera, Paris Musées and Gallica expose different public memory systems: museum objects, open-image filters and digitized national collections. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: Discovery access and reuse permission are separate: Paris Musées marks some public-domain reproductions, while collection and library records require item-level checking.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: No complete public archive was located that preserves every Paris show’s invitations, worker credits, venue plans, source files, rights and commercial outcomes.
